note: Cascaded shadow tuning (docs/06, Shadows). Tier sizes and cascade counts live in quality-tiers.json.
cliffNote: Cliff walls (M2): chunks holding a cliff face cast at full mesh detail within the tier's cliffDetailM (quality-tiers.json), so the shadow matches the wall as drawn. cliffNormalOffsetTexels: extra normal offset on upright faces, scaled by (1 - |n.y|) squared, so a wall grazed by low sun never self-shadows in stripes.
